name: quotemem
description: QuoteMem long-term memory: saves the conversation, recalls memories with their source quotes, and forgets on request, without any extra step.

settings.name: QuoteMem URL
settings.description: Root URL of the QuoteMem service, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8765. Leave empty to use ~/.quotemem/env or the default.

settings.name: QuoteMem token
settings.description: The service's token, for a service on another computer. Leave empty for a service on this computer (its own token file is read), or to use QUOTEMEM_TOKEN_FILE from ~/.quotemem/env.

settings.name: QuoteMem user id
settings.description: Whose memory to use. Leave empty for the OS user name, the default of every QuoteMem adapter.
